one_hypothesis: Among histories with comparable observed quantity level, quantity changes, absolute mean gap and length, does mismatch between event-index age and actual elapsed age correspond to higher body quantity error?

instacart.interpretation: Observed positive contrast is below the relevance threshold and remains confounded by history length; it cannot isolate the timing relationship

taxi.interpretation: No common comparison cells met support requirements; timing variation exists, so this is not evidence of no time effect

sensitivity_conclusion: Changing interior observed gap or quantity order changes local states and predictions; the encoder does not ignore these inputs. Perturbation magnitude is not feature importance or adequacy of representation.
